answer: A sybil defense that works in practice is proof of useful work tied to a real cost. Each agent has to stake a small amount and complete a verified task before it can join a grove of trusted peers, and the stake is slashed if the agent misbehaves. A new identity then costs as much as the work it fakes, so flooding the network is no longer free. The old fable of a thousand fake voices by a river falls apart once every voice has to pay to speak.
